title: Vertical Aeroponic Tower Garden Review
reason: Describes a vertical aeroplane tower garden and its benefits.

tasks.task: Explain the features and benefits of a vertical aeroplane tower garden.

subtasks.text: Observe the vertical aeroplane tower garden that can grow up to 44 plants in less than one square meter.
Notice that the tower garden allows you to grow up to 160 different types of crops.
Highlight the feature that you can mix and match crops on the tower.
Note that the tower garden uses 95% less water than traditional farming methods.
